result: In `sync_fifo_core`, replace the dynamically indexed memory read with a register array whose entries hold queued words in order: shift entries toward the head on each pop, then write accepted input at the post-pop tail, with push taking priority if both updates target the same entry. Drive `out_data` from the head register and retain the occupancy-based `out_valid`, combinational `in_ready`, explicit capacity behavior, and synchronous reset of queue state. Preserve full simultaneous pop/push, stable head data during stalls, minimum transfer age, and the current top’s `// @latency 1` annotation; keep `sync_fifo_core` defined and live-reached from `sync_fifo`.
